❤️ J-RED Loop 126 — MEDIUM, MOCK/TEST-ONLY. Add regression tests for the existing RelayCoreAdapter's full prepare/preflight/dispatch/collect/classify lifecycle when supplied a response derived from ONE LOCAL FAKE ACP subprocess via existing mock mapper. This is a synthetic fixture handoff, NOT a live ACP/provider bridge. Do not create or wire any production integration.

Allowed changed path ONLY: tests/relay/test_acp_client.py. All production code and other tests are READ-ONLY. No new files, dependencies, providers, credentials, network, real agent binaries or service calls.

Read first:
- tests/relay/test_acp_client.py::TestACPMockPhase0EndToEnd (existing fake ACP handshake_script and 2-chunk positive)
- tests/relay/test_core_adapter.py::RecordingBridge and TestCoreAdapter.valid_openai_config/preflight/collect tests
- src/relay/acp_client.py::acp_mock_text_update_wire and acp_mock_text_to_phase0_raw
- src/relay/core_adapter.py::RelayCoreAdapter and src/relay/bridge.py::RelayProviderAdapterBridge.
Reuse existing fixtures and interfaces; avoid new generic frameworks.

In tests/relay/test_acp_client.py, add a focused unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase test or two:
A. Positive MOCK-only lifecycle:
1. Instantiate RecordingBridge and RelayCoreAdapter("openai", bridge, static config equivalent to TestCoreAdapter.valid_openai_config, with auth_kind="account", route_evidence all unsafe routes false). This provider string is for static configuration validation ONLY; never invoke real OpenAI/Claude/Codex/Google/Jules processes.
2. Use adapter.prepare with a small copied case_context including correlation_id, session_id, payload and timeout_seconds; assert original case_context unchanged, provider_id injected in prepared copy. Call adapter.preflight(prepared) and assert ok True, static_configuration_status PASS, live_ready False and live_readiness BLOCKED; no live readiness claim.
3. Call adapter.dispatch(prepared), assert returned handle live_process_started is False, provider/session/correlation match, and bridge.dispatch_count == 1. This is the EXISTING in-memory mock bridge, which does not start any subprocess.
4. Separately run ONE local deterministic fake ACP child via await acp_mock_text_update_wire(sys.executable, "-c", inline_script, cwd=tempfile.gettempdir(), prompt_text="..."). Script must assert ACP initialize/session-new/session-prompt JSON-RPC ids 0/1/2 and expected prompt/session, then send 2 text notifications including Unicode and newline and terminal stopReason=end_turn. Do NOT let the bridge dispatch the child: it is a separate explicitly fake fixture.
5. Convert result using acp_mock_text_to_phase0_raw, assert exact phase0-response-v1 envelope with safety_warning UNKNOWN, evidence_refs [], marker_echoes all null, text unchanged. Inject ONLY its UTF-8 string into bridge.mock_collect_result={"rawResponse":raw_bytes.decode("utf-8")}; call adapter.collect(handle), assert collected bytes equal mapped bytes and RecordingBridge.collect_called_with is exact handle. Call adapter.classify(collected_bytes), assert COMPLETE/PARTICIPANT/success True; assert dispatch_count exactly 1, no abort, no invented evidence, no live process started. Distinguish successful MOCK classification from actual provider execution.
B. Negative fail-closed case: local fake ACP returns valid text chunk but stopReason=refusal (or cancelled). The mapper must reject it; assert NO bridge dispatch, NO bridge collect, NO successful classification, and no fabricated response. If straightforward, add another negative: inject deliberately invalid schema or marker_echoes into the in-memory mock bridge, collect it, assert adapter.classify returns UNKNOWN/success False (do not claim a valid answer).
C. Keep tests deterministic, bounded and short; use existing TestACPMockPhase0EndToEnd.handshake_script rather than duplicate long setup when practical. Do not introduce a wrapper that could be reused for live providers. Do not modify production dispatch, provider adapter, authorization, safety classification or readiness.

Validation: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest tests.relay.test_acp_client -v; PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v; python -m compileall -q src tests; git diff --check. Publish Jules PR on isolated work branch.
